notes.title: To Kill A King - Absolute Edition - Version 3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Massive update to the game overall. [/h1]

- Old save files will not work! Please delete. Sadly I am not able to make them work with the new content and revision! My apologies!

- Sideview battle is now available with animated enemies. 

- New enemies and bosses to slay and vent Rot's frustration.

- New items, weapons, armor and accessories. 

- New infusion items.

- Stat point distribution system added with each new level up!

- Void Art skills added.

- Rots now has a new look!

- Remade Battle UI and tweaked menu screen.

- New achievements!

- Visual upgrades to the weapons Rots uses in battle.

- New victory aftermath screen and music.

- Flying Dragon mount added to traverse the overworld faster! But where and how to unlock..?

- Revamped skills and abilities

- New item and skill to escape dungeons added.

- Numerous bugs, grammar, word spacing, and fixes to the entire game! (Please forgive me for not having these things already taken care of!)

- I want to thank you to everyone who has given the game a try and been part of giving me feedback. This latest revision was based on the feedback I have received. I appreciate the critiques and enjoy any criticism, good or bad. I am a one man army working on this project. Feel free to please let me know of any issues or bugs you may find. I truly think I got them all this time. If I haven't I apologize and will do my best to correct the issue post haste.

Thanks for playing! 
1SiGn Games - Mikey

notes.title: Update 2 and 1/3
notes.content:
Added "To Desktop" option from in game menu screen instead of having to use "To Title" and then the "Quit" option.
Game will now open into Full Screen now. Use F4 if you want to exit full screen back into windowed mode.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed issue with in-game weather not working properly.

notes.title: To Kill A King Revised 2.0!
notes.content:
After much deliberation with Rots, we have finally come to an agreement and made some changes and updates to the game.

Elemental Weaknesses and Strengths - Rots as well as every enemy out for her head can exploit one another. 

Infusion System - Rots has the inherent ability to fuse random objects (preferably pieces of fallen foes) to her weapons, armor, and accessories. Allowing for more customization to her stats and how you choose to play the game.

Pissed Off - Is no longer a usable ability. Instead when Rots receives damage, she has a chance to get pissed off for the duration of the fight.

Magic Man - Locate Magic Man and learn new spells to bring pain and rampant destruction upon Rots' foes.

Bounties - Purchase bounties from the Bounty Hunter and locate the targets (dead not alive) and reap some rewards.

Rots now has access to Inherent, Conflict, and Reinforce abilities. Find, or learn at level up!

More enemies to further infuriate Rots! New dungeons and locations to explore! (Irksome Pyramid)

In game and Steam achievements now available.

Special thanks to everyone that has given feedback for To Kill A King. It was a blast making the game, and detouring from the cliche norm that plagues most of the genre. My goal was to stay classic in a sense with a modern flair. Thank you again to all that have given TKAK a try! ːMHRISE_Felyneː

notes.title: Major Revision Coming Soon
notes.content:
Major revision in the works. Fixed some bugs and errors that feedback was provided for. Thank you to those that have brought them to my attention.

More monsters, dungeons, and characters to further enrage Rot's! New "Infusion" system coming and lots more content on the horizon.

notes.title: Minor Update #4
notes.content:
Update to overall enemy stats for a bit more balance and challenge.

Rots and all enemies can now suffer from Hemorrhage. Black Ooze is your best friend to cure this ailment!

Some enemies have a chance to drop a Scroll of Worthless Knowledge! Or is it worthless...?

Fix to some spacing issues in dialogue and text.

New equipment and weapons have been added!

Rots and I had another argument over clouds..... and per the usual Rots won that debate.....

notes.title: Minor Fix and Update #3
notes.content:
Fixed spacing issues in dialogue along with several grammar issues overlooked. Rot's was pissed about this. 

Rot's also decided that there was only room for one Dark Lord in the menu screen. This has been updated to comply with orders. Menu screen has been updated.

Game font has been updated to reflect Rot's personality more..... not like it's that great of a personality to begin with.... *cough*

Corrected issue with Rot's Absolute Power portrait and attire.... was not to complete satisfaction.

Window skin and buttons have also been updated to reflect Rot's taste.....

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Rot's Book of Collected Shit and Log of Assholes has been added.

Book of Collected Shit keeps track of all collected items and their relative stats, etc.

Log of Assholes keeps track of all the assholes and enemies Rots has to deal with.

Advanced stats and parameters in the Status window have been added!

notes.title: To Kill A King Revised!
notes.content:
[u][b]Major Update for To Kill A King![/b][/u]

Converted to RPG Maker MV!

Improved resolution and full screen up to 1280x720!

Rots is now able to equip: Weapon, Armor, Shield, Boots, Gloves, Helmet, and two Accessories!

New gear and items to find and equip to help Rots seek revenge.

103 enemies to annoy and piss off Rots!

Full controller support including keyboard configuration, game-pad configuration, or use of a mouse!

Improved weather effects!

Better balancing with the enemy resulting in fewer trips to the inn!

New and corrected dialogues. More of your favorite pissed off neighborhood Rots!

Original save files from RPG Maker VX Ace are not compatible with MV. I had to talk Rots down from a serious rant and cursing over this lol.
